generatedTextures.name: SkinAlbedoTex
generatedTextures.source: Hybrid: input/reference.png facial photograph + procedural skin synthesis
generatedTextures.mappingMethod: 25-landmark Thin-Plate Spline (TPS) warp onto canonical FaceCylUV with 80th-percentile local skin envelope de-hairing (removing forehead/cheek hair wisps), 68% low-frequency delighting, strict eye-aperture exclusion, and cosine-feathered blending into 360-degree color-matched procedural skin on forehead, temples, ears, neck, and back of head.

generatedTextures.name: SkinRoughBumpTex
generatedTextures.source: Hybrid: input/reference.png high-pass facial micro-relief + procedural micro-pores & lip grooves
generatedTextures.mappingMethod: Packed channel map on FaceCylUV: R = TPS-warped photographic high-pass skin/lip relief + procedural pores & lip grooves, G = spatially varying roughness (0.32 lips/nose tip, 0.43 cheeks/forehead, 0.48 neck), B = subsurface scattering weight.

generatedTextures.name: EyeIrisTex
generatedTextures.source: Calibrated from input/reference.png iris pixel sampling + procedural radial iris synthesis
generatedTextures.mappingMethod: Planar polar UV mapping on Eyeball_L / Eyeball_R (r_iris=0.365, r_pupil=0.152) with warm chestnut stroma fibers, collarette ring, dark limbal ring, catchlights, and warm off-white sclera.

generatedTextures.name: HairStrandTex
generatedTextures.source: Calibrated from input/reference.png espresso root, warm chestnut mid-shaft, and copper-brown highlight pixels
generatedTextures.mappingMethod: Longitudinal UV mapping along HairVolumeLocks and ScalpCap with multi-frequency fibrous strand striations and root-to-tip tonal gradient.

generatedTextures.name: SweaterKnitHeightTex
generatedTextures.source: Hybrid: unoccluded sweater patch (x in [0.63,0.77], y in [0.59,0.73]) from input/reference.png + procedural seed/waffle stitch heightmap
generatedTextures.mappingMethod: 2x2 mirror-tiled delighted photographic yarn relief combined with 64x80 interlocking seed/waffle stitch heightmap on KnitUV, driving both Subdivision+Displace modifier and shader Bump.

generatedTextures.name: SweaterKnitAlbedoTex
generatedTextures.source: Hybrid: input/reference.png dusty-pink sweater chromaticity & mirror-tiled yarn grain + procedural stitch crevice AO
generatedTextures.mappingMethod: Seamless UV mapping on KnitUV across torso, shoulders, and sleeves with physically calibrated dusty-rose yarn chromaticity.

limitations: Single-image reference means exact side profile, back hair arrangement, back sweater drapery, and unseen lower torso/hands are anatomically inferred.
Facial likeness is sculpted by deforming the CC0 MakeHuman hm08 base topology combined with landmark-registered TPS photographic albedo projection rather than a multi-camera 3D photogrammetry scan.

Hair combines 78 fluted 8-sided 3D wave locks with 5,700 native 3D HairCurves strands (including 380 see-through bang and curtain-hairline curves) rather than >100,000 individual scalp follicles to stay well within the <1M evaluated vertex and CPU render budget.
Cafe background is a stylized 3D geometric representation (window, plants, wooden tables, counter, and jars) rendered with shallow depth of field.
